fields.headline: THE MEDAL ROUND.
fields.body: Every card its own, counted in strokes, and each team's best cards decide the session.

fields.headline:
STROKES,
NOT HOLES.
fields.body: Everyone plays their own ball for their own net score. There is no match to win or lose: the card is the whole of it.

fields.headline: YOUR OWN SHOTS.
fields.body: Nobody plays off a difference, because there is no opponent to take shots from. Each player takes their course handicap off the tee they are playing, with the format's allowance on top.

fields.headline: BEST CARDS COUNT.
fields.body: You choose how many cards count for each team, so a bigger team cannot win on numbers. A hole left blank is refused rather than guessed.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
